## What MindMedix AI Does

MindMedix AI delivers predictive operational intelligence for European hospitals. We help healthcare systems anticipate workforce challenges, optimize resources, and improve decision-making through responsible AI.

Our platform forecasts staffing shortages, operational stress, and burnout risks **3 weeks in advance**, giving hospital administrators actionable time to intervene.

## Validation

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Crisis detection recall | 97% |
| Overall accuracy (LOWO CV) | 97.1% |
| Validation dataset | 34 real hospital wards |
| Average savings per prevented crisis | €2,400 |
| Prediction horizon | 3 weeks |

## Target Audience

- Hospital directors and administrators
- Healthcare operations leaders
- HR directors in healthcare systems
- Regional health authorities (Italy, Europe)
- Strategic innovation partners
- Investors in healthcare AI

## Key Problems Solved

1. **Structural nursing shortage**: 175,000 unfilled positions in Italy alone
2. **Emergency overtime costs**: €2.4B annual impact from unplanned overtime
3. **Burnout crisis**: 59% of staff report chronic stress
4. **Reactive operations**: Most hospitals discover crises only when they occur

## How It Works

1. **Data ingestion**: Anonymized shift schedules, absenteeism, patient acuity
2. **Feature engineering**: 30+ operational risk indicators
3. **Prediction model**: XGBoost multiclass classifier trained on 34 hospital wards
4. **Alert system**: 3-week-ahead risk flags per ward (green/yellow/red)
5. **Dashboard**: Board-level operational intelligence interface

## Engineering Principles

- Security by Design
- Privacy by Design (GDPR Art. 89)
- Responsible AI
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Reliability
- Maintainability

## Compliance & Standards

- GDPR ready
- EU AI Act ready
- ISO 27001 readiness (in progress)
- Not a medical device (no clinical decision support)
- Zero patient data — only anonymized operational metadata

## Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Web frontend | Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS |
| Backend | NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis |
| AI/ML | Python, XGBoost, scikit-learn |
| Infrastructure | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform |
| CI/CD | GitHub Actions, CodeQL |
| Monitoring | Grafana, Prometheus |

## Repository Architecture (GitHub)

- **mindmedix-web** (Public): Marketing site, customer dashboard, hospital portal
- **mindmedix-platform** (Private): Backend APIs, auth, hospital integrations
- **mindmedix-ai-engine** (Private): Prediction models, inference, evaluation
- **mindmedix-datasets** (Private): Dataset schemas, synthetic generators
- **mindmedix-infrastructure** (Private): Docker, K8s, Terraform, monitoring
- **mindmedix-docs** (Private): Architecture, ADRs, runbooks, compliance
- **sdk-typescript** (Public): TypeScript SDK for MindMedix AI APIs
- **sdk-python** (Public): Python SDK for MindMedix AI APIs
